brief: Synthetic supervised-learning diagram. Samples enter an encoder, features go to a prediction head, and the head emits predictions. Predictions and ground-truth targets enter the objective. The objective supplies a parameter-update relation to the encoder. Explicitly distinguish this training relation from the forward data flow; do not imply that the loss output is an inference input. Only show the stated encoder update, not unstated gradients to other modules.
title: Forward computation and training feedback
caption: Illustrative architecture. Solid: forward data flow. Orange dashed: objective inputs. Gray dashed: encoder parameter update during training.
